Steeple Tip Finial for 4 x 4 Hinges

text.description_html:
Emtek 97314, Solid Brass Steeple Tip Finial for 4 inch x 4 inch Hinges

An easy screw-on installation makes this hinge finial an effortless way to add the finishing details that help turn a house into a beautiful home. The Steeple finial is made by Emtek out of durable solid brass. This Steeple Tip is for use with Emtek 4" x 4" plain, heavy duty, or ball bearing hinges. Each set is packed with 4 finials--the perfect amount for a pair of hinges.

Hinge Finials (tips) are packaged and sold as a set of 4. One set is perfect for use on a pair of hinges with finials on both the top and bottom of each hinge.

Specifications of the Emtek Steeple Tip Finial:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Overall Height: 1-3/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Maximum Diameter: 1/2"
  • Easy screw-on installation
  • 4 finials per set.
  • For use with 4" x 4" heavy duty, plain, or ball bearing Emtek made brass hinges.

Sold as a Set of 4. each Set is enough for 1 pair of hinges.
